title: Case 032: Broken Window
initial_request: I own the property at 132 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 5ZZ, and my tenant has told me a window is broken. I don't yet know when or how it happened; can you help me make a claim?
overview: Jess Moore contacted her broker, Ben Hale of Stonebridge Risk, after her tenant reported a broken window at 132 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 5ZZ. Ben requested the incident details and materials, and separately asked Jess to arrange safe temporary closure of the opening. Jess confirmed a contractor had secured it and supplied a written description of the damage and what was known about its discovery. Ben then submitted the claim to Wrenfield Property Insurance and recorded that it had been sent; no insurer decision is recorded.

next_action.summary: At the clarification stage, establish when and how the damage was discovered, identify the window materials and damage, and confirm that a contractor has safely secured the opening before submission.

outcome: The claim has been submitted to Wrenfield Property Insurance; no decision on acceptance or cover has been received.

events.body: My tenant has reported that a window is broken at 132 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 5ZZ. I don't know when it happened or what caused it, and would appreciate your help with making a claim.

Before I submit anything, please tell me when the tenant first noticed the damage, what they know about how it occurred, and what the frame and glazing are made of. Please also arrange for a contractor to make the opening safe; the tenant should not attempt repairs themselves.

A contractor has temporarily secured the opening, so the tenant is safe while we look into this. The tenant found the window broken early in the morning and did not see how it happened; the timber frame is split near the latch and the glass pane is shattered.
Thank you. To complete the incident details, could you confirm whether the tenant last saw the window intact the previous evening and whether the window is single or double glazed?

The tenant says the window was intact when they closed it the previous evening and found it broken the following morning. It is double glazed, and they did not witness the damage or identify its cause.

Please register a property claim for the broken double-glazed window at 132 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 5ZZ. The tenant found it shattered the morning after last seeing it intact; the timber frame is split near the latch, the cause is unknown, and a contractor has temporarily secured the opening. Our broker submission reference is SUB-032; please provide an insurer claim number if you register it.
Recorded that submission SUB-032 was sent to Wrenfield Property Insurance. No response confirming acceptance, cover or liability is recorded.
